description: Canonical machine index of the v1 standard relation_kind vocabulary. This registry is the machine source for the kind list, default cardinality class, truth-source class, and writability; detailed dedupe keys, scope rules, and conflict semantics remain normative in zh/models/relation.md sections 3-6.
registry_rules: relation.schema.json relation_kind stays a free string so extension profiles can introduce new kinds; kinds listed here are the v1 standard vocabulary and MUST follow their registered row.

A relation_kind not present here and not declared by an extension profile is an unregistered kind: implementations SHOULD preserve it as an opaque edge marked unknown_relation_kind in projections and MUST NOT infer container, dependency, or visibility semantics from it (relation.md section 3.1).

Rows (or shapes) with truth_source_class=derived_projection MUST NOT be written via ak.relation.create / update / delete; the listed write_path Move or durable event is the only truth source and direct Relation writes MUST be rejected with schema_violation.

Every shape_dependent row MUST declare per-shape writability=derived_only or direct. SDK constructors MUST resolve the most-specific matching (canonical_id,from,to) shape before selecting an event path; wildcard fallback applies only when no specific shape matches.
weak_semantic=true rows are non-structural, non-cascading reference edges; they never imply containment, lifecycle coupling, or visibility changes.

Relations not declared multi-edge dedupe on the full tuple (realm_id, relation_kind, from_ref, to_ref); concurrent duplicate creation resolves per relation.md section 6 deterministic_winner unless the relation profile declares another on_conflict value.

shapes.cardinality: one_to_many; single active board parent per list

relation_kinds.notes: Canonical direction Strand -> DID; full-tuple dedupe, not per-actor single value. Single-owner semantics require a RelationProfile tightening (max_to_per_from=1).
Setting a new default View MUST close the previous active edge.
from/to types MUST be declared by Realm schema / RelationProfile; without a profile it is a generic weak reference edge.
Same profile-declared typing rule as summarized_from.
Derived from cell ak.component.strand.watch.v1; direct Relation writes MUST schema_violation. from_ref MUST be a DID, to_ref a Strand (or profiled watchable).
Circle-scoped on the private Strand side; target-side reverse relation MUST NOT be written.
